outside_intervention: B11 G_visibility, including immediate feedback and original action and return protection

intervention.timing: First native planning call that passes the observed junction test. The one-call treatment ends after native selection, even if a guard then rejects the route. Nontriggers retain the whole neutral policy run.
intervention.start_axis: Require current heading equal to received initial heading and camera center within two lateral cells of the initial axis.
intervention.current_view: Count valid current-frame first-hit facility pixels without distinguishing open from closed, at +/- 6 percent of image width from the principal point. Require at least 16 pixels on each side.
intervention.route_side: In the first 28 outbound primitives, use the first state whose lateral position relative to current center deviates by at least 3 cells. Left is negative displacement in the current camera-right direction. Record null when there is no such state.
intervention.paired_candidates: Among the original region-allowed candidates, require a left-right pair whose absolute outbound costs differ by at most 6 and whose reserved return costs differ by at most 8. This qualifies the event, but all original candidates remain eligible.

mode.X: complement the two shape-prior probabilities of each measured support-track model; keep the B11 T16 posterior recomputation, fit, shape hypotheses, and measured input identical

intervention.selection: Original v10_3_1 score-descending, cost-ascending, candidate-ID-ascending, with native above-zero requirement. No manual route or mode-specific candidate addition.

budget_policy: No adaptation based on outcomes. Every normal early stop and execution failure is retained with actual paid actions.
